question: By whose agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā extend up to māyā?
premises: A yoginī named Icchā is identified.
The action reaches up to māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, with the siddhas, extends up to māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The exact verbal action governing māyāntaṃ is implicit.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, together with the siddhas, reaches up to māyā by supreme will.
